scenarios.name: retry_safe_intent
scenarios.evidence: SIGKILL after PostgreSQL intent commit; recovery requeued assignment; subsequent lease generation increased

scenarios.name: external_effect_uncertainty
scenarios.evidence: SIGKILL after isolated test effect commit; restart recovery moved assignment to awaiting_steward; effect row remained exactly one; unrelated assignment completed its worker cycle

scenarios.name: result_before_state_transition
scenarios.evidence: SIGKILL after persisted result commit and before state transition; restart recovery moved assignment to awaiting_verification; independent verifier accepted it; later recovery pass left completed assignment terminal

scenarios.name: recovery_idempotency
scenarios.evidence: one recovery record per assignment/generation; subsequent reconciliation did not emit duplicate decisions

scenarios.name: legacy_or_unclassified_action
scenarios.evidence: implementation defaults missing/unknown effect classification to no blind replay and Steward wait

scenarios.name: independent_assignment_progress
scenarios.evidence: unrelated work was claimable and processed in the same restarted worker cycle after recovering uncertain work
